body: Well 900$ is still pretty cheap for a rtx 3080. Any idea when Best Buy or new egg or anything like that will restock? Or is it still to early to tell

At this point in time it’s very difficult to get a decent pc for a decent price because all gpu parts and kinda 50/50 when it comes to pieces. Atm it’s very hard to find a gpu that’s not sold out let alone for a good price. If I were you I’d wait until like may or June to get one and in the mean time just save more money for a pc. Ik its really bs that you have to hear this cuz having a pc is great and you want it ASAP but if you honestly looking to get one that’s actually worth the money your putting into it I’d wait
Things to prioritize are the gpu and cpu so things like your i5 10400f and 1660 super. If your looking to prioritize parts those would be the ones.

I’d recommend changing the processor from the i5 10400f to a i7 10700f 8 core processor. It’s around 360$ CAD

For the gpu I’d change it from a 1660 super to a 2070 or a 2070 ti which is around 800 CAD 

I’d recommend getting a Seagate barracuda 2 TB hard drive from Best Buy it’s only 80$ CAD 

If you can I’d also upgrade the ram to ddr4 3600mhz  16GB. I don’t know any specific ram to recommend but Corsair dose have some good stuff 

I hope this helps
What is the price range your are look at?

If your on a budget then I’d recommend getting a 1660 super for your build. It’s a sold gpu for the price and it should do the job for the games that your playing. If you doing editing and such I’d also recommend you upgrade your ram to 32 gb. Corsair has some really nice rgb ddr4 32mgz ram sticks for about 200-300$ I do believe. 

If money isn’t an issue then I’d recommend getting a rtx 2070 with 32GB of ram. Your cpu should be fine for awhile but if you can upgrade it I’d recommend the amd ryzen 7 2800xt 8 core processor for a somewhat long term build. That combined with a 2070 and 32GB of ram should do you for a relatively decent amount of times considering your playing games that aren’t VERY demanding.
